motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Mock to approve consent items 3A through 3C.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to approve consent items 3A through 3C. The motion carried, 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Havlick, to approve the draft letter of opposition to RTD regarding the proposed elimination of the Neighborhood and Business Eco pass programs.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to approve the draft letter of opposition to RTD regarding the proposed elimination of the Neighborhood and Business Eco pass programs. The motion carried: 8:0, Councilmember Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Riggle moved, seconded by Ruzzin, to adopt Resolution No. 924 regarding the City's position on the Boulder Valley School District's proposed school closures and consolidations.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on the motion to adopt Resolution No. 924 regarding the City's position on the Boulder Valley School District's proposed school closures and consolidations as amended. The motion carried 8:0; Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Ruzzin to accept staff recommendations #1 and #2 and by the first meeting in June to have #3 and #4 come back as well as an analysis of the Education Excise Tax rate and potential future needs.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:1; Havlick opposed; Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson to approve Ordinance No. 7267 amending Ordinance No. 6080 (1999) designating the Downtown area as a historic district under the city of Boulder Historic Preservation Code. The proposed amendment will amend the boundaries of the Downtown Historic District to include the property at 2121 Broadway.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0 as amended to correct "Hillside to Downtown" in the ordinance ; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Ruzzin moved, seconded by Mock to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7269 approving supplemental appropriations to the 2003 Budget as amended.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:1; Havlick opposed, Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Mock moved, seconded by Ruzzin to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7270 amending Section 4-20-25, "Monthly Water User Charges" and Section 11-1-49, "Water Conservation Measures," B.R.C. 1981, to increase the treated water quantity charge for inside and outside city water and to establish a surcharge during a drought.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Havlick to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7271 adopting Supplement No. 75 which codifies previously adopted Ordinance Nos. 7227, 7233, 7234, 7235, 7240, 7242, 7243, 7247, 7248, 7252, and 7254 as an amendment to the Boulder Revised Code 1981, and setting forth details in relation thereto.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0; Morzel and Riggle absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Ruzzin moved, seconded by Mock to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7272 amending Ordinance No. 5896 (1997) by revising the impasse resolution procedure utilized when the city reaches impasse with one of its bargaining units.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:0; Morzel and Riggle absent.
